description: Opposing-cue duration trial after length-specific Rac and bound-MCA steady state: mirrored 60-, 300-, 1200-, 7200-, or 86400-s cues in the beta=1x full model.

metadata.settling_rule: both Rac and bound-MCA x50/L enter and remain within 0.002 of their final 1000-s median, no later than 10000 s after conditioning withdrawal
